visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Digits Are Added, Not Placed
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Reversing 9043 should print 3409, but the program prints 16.

solution.explanation: Without multiplying by 10, each new digit is just added to the total, so the digits are summed (3+4+0+9 = 16). Multiplying rev by 10 first moves the digits already collected one place to the left.
